LanguageData.MI_MorphineTolerance.label: morphine tolerance
LanguageData.MI_MorphineTolerance.description: A built-up tolerance to morphine. The more severe this tolerance is, the more morphine it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.MI_MorphineAddiction.label: morphine addiction
LanguageData.MI_MorphineAddiction.description: Requires regular morphine to avoid withdrawal. Sustained abstinence eventually resolves the addiction.
